title: Cokret Moderation Appeal
description: Payload shapes for the four ck.moderation.appeal.* event kinds (submit / review / decision / close) that close the moderation appeal loop. Each kind writes the ck.component.moderation_appeal.v1 cell on a deterministic state machine: (none) → submitted → under_review → decided → closed. The decided state additionally records the verdict (uphold / overturn / modify); overturn MUST be paired in the same Anchor batch with a ck.moderation.decision.lift event referencing the original decision. All payloads carry realm_id and reducers MUST require it to equal the enclosing Event.realm_id and the appealed decision's Realm. See zh/governance/content-moderation.md §5.5 (appeal flow). Capability: ck.moderation.appeal.submit (any member, low risk) for submit; ck.moderation.appeal.review (moderator) for the other three.

realm_id.description: Realm whose moderation decision is being appealed. MUST equal the enclosing Event.realm_id and the Realm of decision_ref / target_ref unless an explicit cross-Realm moderation profile authorizes otherwise.

decision_ref.description: Reference to the ck.moderation.decision event being appealed.

target_ref.description: The original moderation target (message, flow, member, blob, etc.) — same typed-id form as the appealed decision's target.

evidence_visibility.description: Who may decrypt / read the appeal evidence narrative. Default per Realm policy; SHOULD be reviewers_only for sensitive disputes. The visibility tag MUST enter projection / redaction decisions; it does NOT change wire encryption of the envelope, only the cleartext audience for evidence fields.

submit_payload.description: ck.moderation.appeal.submit — opens the appeal. Writes appeal cell (state=submitted). MUST be issued by an appellant who is the original moderation target's controller (member appealing their own ban / message removal) or by an authorized advocate listed in Realm policy. appellant MUST hold ck.moderation.appeal.submit capability.

appellant.description: Actor lodging the appeal. MUST be the original moderation target's controller or an authorized advocate.

reason_text_ref.description: Reference (typically blob_ref or in-line short string) to the appeal narrative / supporting argument. For E2EE Realms this is an encrypted reference.

evidence_refs.description: Optional supporting evidence (blob refs, prior message ids, witness DIDs).

review_payload.description: ck.moderation.appeal.review — reviewer takes the appeal under review. Transitions cell state submitted → under_review. Reviewer MUST hold ck.moderation.appeal.review capability; the same actor MUST NOT review their own moderation decision (separation of duties enforced by reducer).

decision_payload.description: ck.moderation.appeal.decision — reviewer's verdict. Transitions cell state under_review → decided. Verdict semantics: uphold = original decision stands, no further action; overturn = original decision reversed, this event MUST be paired in the same Anchor batch with a ck.moderation.decision.lift event whose target equals decision_ref (reducer rejects with appeal_overturn_missing_lift otherwise); modify = original decision adjusted (parameters revised), modify_decision_ref MUST point to a new ck.moderation.decision event in the same batch that supersedes the original.

reason_text_ref.description: Reference to the verdict rationale. MUST be present for audit trail; visibility follows evidence_visibility on the submit event.

modify_decision_ref.description: Required iff verdict=modify. Points to the replacement ck.moderation.decision event in the same Anchor batch.

close_payload.description: ck.moderation.appeal.close — closes the appeal after the decided window expires (default 30 days configurable per Realm policy). Transitions cell state decided → closed. Locks against re-appealing the same (decision_ref, appellant) pair within the policy cool-off window; new appeals after the cool-off are allowed via a fresh appeal_id.

closer.description: Actor or service closing the appeal. If auto_closed=true, reducer MUST require closer to be a timer service DID listed in Realm policy and MUST enforce closed_at >= decided_at + appeal_window_ms.

auto_closed.description: true iff the close was triggered by a timer (decided + Realm.appeal_window_ms <= now); false iff explicitly closed by an authorized actor.
